Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.web.controller

Class ArticleController

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.web.controller.ArticleController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/v1") public class ArticleController extends Object
REST controller exposing the article query endpoint.

Provides GET /api/v1/articles?topic={topic}&limit={limit}&daysBack={daysBack} to allow callers to query harvested articles. The topic parameter uses case-insensitive substring matching (e.g. "health" matches "Anthropic Healthcare AI" and "HuggingFace Healthcare LLMs").

The daysBack parameter is optional; when omitted the adapter uses its configured default from aihealthcare.articles.days-back.

This controller never references the JPA adapter, repository, or any infrastructure class directly — it depends only on the domain port interface.

    • listArticles

      @GetMapping("/articles") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<List<ArticleResponse>> listArticles(@RequestParam String topic, @RequestParam(defaultValue="20") int limit, @RequestHeader(value="X-Subscriber-Email",required=false) String subscriberEmail)
      Returns persisted articles matching the given topic keyword.

      Topic matching is case-insensitive substring search — "health" matches "Anthropic Healthcare AI", "Google Health AI", etc.

      Parameters:
      topic - keyword to match against article topics (case-insensitive contains)
      limit - maximum number of articles to return (default 20)
      Returns:
      200 OK with a list of ArticleResponse DTOs
